primary_endpoint: Absolute change in liver fat content by MRI-PDFF from baseline to Week 18.
efficacy_outcome: LFC changed by −2.918 with 500 mg BID and −4.829 with 1000 mg BID, versus −1.962 with placebo; p=0.199 and p=0.011, respectively (ANCOVA).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 1/33 participants on 500 mg HTD1801, 1/34 on 1000 mg, and 1/33 on placebo; no deaths.
